name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: U.S. Strikes Iran Over Strait of Hormuz Mines, Trump Says
changes.summary: Iranian officials said the strikes caused significant damage, including killing four people and injuring several dozens at a wedding. Iran said it retaliated by firing on U.S. bases in the region.

changes.title: Markey defeats Moulton in Massachusetts' Democratic primary for Senate
changes.summary: Incumbent Sen. Ed Markey has won the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate in Massachusetts.

changes.title: Victim in Times Square stabbing identified as Bank of America employee Erin Piacenti
changes.summary: Erin Piacenti was identified as one of the two people stabbed by a woman Monday afternoon in Times Square before police shot and killed the suspect.

changes.title: Thousands of U.S. service members arrive in Thailand after record stint at sea
changes.summary: About 5,000 U.S. sailors and Marines are stopping in the resort city of Pattaya for a “rest and relaxation” break as they return home from a record-setting deployment in the Middle East.

changes.title: The Navy’s Logistical Nightmare in the Iran War
changes.summary: Amid a crew morale crisis, the military has replaced the U.S.S. Abraham Lincoln in the Middle East with another aircraft carrier. Our Pentagon reporter John Ismay, a Navy veteran, explains how the challenges to supply ships in the area will most likely remain the same.

changes.title: Exploring U.S. Open food trends, beyond the Honey Deuce
changes.summary: The U.S. Open is bringing good eating to the tennis tournament. Adam Chandler, food trends columnist at the Wall Street Journal, weighs in on the U.S. Open's fan experience strategy.

changes.title: Iran war ramps up again amid series of resignations and firings in U.S. military
changes.summary: Strikes between the U.S. and Iran are ratcheting back up amid an important resignation in the U.S. military. CBS News national security analyst Aaron MacLean reports.

changes.title: Markey, Neal, and Lynch projected winners in Massachusetts Democratic primaries
changes.summary: NBC News’ Steve Kornacki breaks down numbers in the Democratic primary races in Massachusetts including U.S. Senate and House Districts 8 and 1.

changes.title: US and Iran Trade New Strikes as the War Enters its 7th Month
changes.summary: The United States and Iran are exchanging new attacks across the Middle East, following days of renewed threats from both sides. CENTCOM says the U.S. struck Iranian air defense sites, radar systems and other military targets in response to Iran’s recent attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. NBC’s Gar.

changes.title: Chevron to expand in Venezuela, days after the U.S. and Venezuela strike oil deal
changes.summary: Chevron is the largest foreign oil operator in Venezuela. The deal will expand its footprint at a time of political and economic uncertainty for Venezuela. (Image credit: FEDERICO PARRA/AFP via Getty Images).
